pass_rule: For every dataset and lane, attack accuracy must not be significantly greater than the majority baseline at alpha=0.05; any lane with p<0.05 fails.
input_boundary: Only manifest identifiers and causally visible runtime document layout are attack features. Document body tokens, quarantine truth, closure content, label files, and post-hoc telemetry are forbidden.
claim_boundary: Passing only rejects the registered simple side-channel attacks on the development split; it does not prove absence of all leakage or generalization safety.
